documents.title: UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED ON 30-09-2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For The Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30-09-2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported robust financial performance for fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging 22.60% to 3,188 lakhs and gross sales reaching 34,126 lakhs. Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products increased to 29,311 metric tonnes driven by enhanced capacity utilization from newly commissioned plant and machinery. The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park in Tamil Nadu, commenced local logistics and trading activities, and placed orders for manufacturing machinery. Management also recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share) for the financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and commenced logistics and trading activities.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and made advance payment.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power such as solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at competitive prices while maintaining stable finished goods selling prices and discontinuing low-margin product lines.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods. This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cash profit during the year was driven by arranging cheaper raw materials, maintaining existing sales prices, stopping production of low-profit items, and lowering finance costs through loans from Yes Bank Limited.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued. Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes compared to 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 metric tonnes of PVC flooring, sheetings, films, etc., during the year compared to 26,755 metric tonnes in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Higher capacity utilization was achieved through the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.15 per equity share of Rs.1/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2026 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The board transferred an amount of Rs. 400 Lakh to General Reserves during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the sub-division of existing equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 each to Rs. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 17th May, 2024 considered and approved the proposal of restructuring the Share Capital of the Company by sub-dividing the existing equity shares into face value of Rs. 1/- per share in place of Rs. 5/- per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: The National Stock Exchange of India Limited levied a penalty of Rs. 50,000 for delay in uploading the Integrated Filing containing Related Party Transactions disclosures.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the period, the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) has levied a penalty of ₹50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) for delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing details of Related Party Transactions pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 on the NEAPS portal. For quarter September 30,2025. Which was duly paid by the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the past was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Shri Ram Babu Verma is re-appointed as Executive Director for a period of twelve months effective from December 27, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: It is, therefore, proposed to reappoint Shri Ram Babu Verma as an Executive Director of the Company in the Thirty Second Annual General Meeting for a further period of twelve (12) months with effect from 27/12/2024 under Schedule V to the Companies Act,2013 at the existing salary & perquisites, as given in the Notice of Thirty Second Annual General Meeting.

management_commitments.claim: Shri Amitaabh Goenka is re-appointed as Managing Director and CEO for a period of thirty-six months effective from July 13, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: It is, therefore, proposed to reappoint Shri Amitaabh Goenka as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the company in the Thirty Second Annual General Meeting for a further period of Thirty Six (36) months with effect from 13/07/2025 under Schedule V to the Companies Act,2013 at the existing salary & perquisites, as given in the Notice of Thirty Second Annual General Meeting.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
